Hi Adi,
I'm not that familiar with sbt but I believe it uses the same maven dependency resolution system as Maven, so you should be able to add the equivalent of the following to your build:

<dependency>
    <groupId>org.renjin</groupId>
    <artifactId>parent</artifactId>
    <version>0.7.0-RC8-SNAPSHOT</version>
</dependency>

HTH,
Alex
